references.text: Repeats the commandment about six days of work and rest on the seventh day, with a focus on rest for workers and animals.
Confirms the principle of six days of work followed by Sabbath rest as holy to the Lord.
Repeats the commandment about six days of work and rest on the seventh day, even during plowing and harvest seasons.
Moses conveys the Lord's command regarding six days of work and Sabbath rest on the seventh day.
The Sabbath commandment in connection with the holy festivals, emphasizing the working days and the day of rest.
Parallel passage in Deuteronomy that repeats the commandment about six days of work and Sabbath rest.
Ezekiel describes the Sabbath commandment in connection with temple service, referencing the six working days.
The synagogue leader refers to the six working days as opposed to the Sabbath when Jesus healed.
